_comment: builds/corpus -- the builds every upstream update runs Rust = LuaJIT on (builds/README.md, UPDATE-PROMPT.md). Not copies: each set names where its XMLs already live. `$POB` = pobRoot, `$ORACLE` = oracleRoot of tools/upstream.json; other paths are repo-relative globs. LuaJIT truth: `node tools/lua-corpus/export-real.ts --set corpus` -> builds/corpus-fixtures/ (gitignored, re-taken on every update); gate: crates/pob-calc/tests/real_builds.rs. Oracle goldens of the 6 golden builds: builds/corpus/goldens/*.json (tools/make-goldens.ts).

sets.what: the 6 golden builds (upstream spec/TestBuilds/3.13 + the Lethal Pride fixture of pob-engine-wasm); oracle snapshots in goldens/
R7 synthetic offence scenarios + R7-synth-2 (`s2-*`; R8 scenarios reuse these and the goldens) (tools/lua-corpus/export-offence-synth.ts)
